posts.trend: Furniture and appliance rental plans from around Rs 2,699/month are growing across Indian metros against Rs 3-4 lakh setup costs.
posts.context: Urban migrants in their late 20s and early 30s who move frequently and cannot afford or justify buying permanent furniture.
posts.angle: Our parents built permanent lives with heavy steel; we rent a temporary existence that can be repossessed if our card declines.
slides: Compare your assets with what your father owned at your age.

At 30, your father bought a Godrej steel almirah.
It survived three house shifts.
It survived two city moves.
It is currently holding your original degree certificate.

You pay ₹2,699 a month for a bed.

If you miss the subscription, they take your sleep.
posts.caption: The modern asset-light lifestyle. 🛏️
